questions.question: L is 3 years older to M. M is 6 years younger to N. N is 4 years older to O. O is 7 years younger to P. Who is the youngest?
questions.solution:
L is 3 years older to M.

L = M + 3

M is 6 years younger to N.

N = M + 6

N is 4 years older to O.

N = O + 4

O is 7 years younger to P.

O = P - 7

Now, P > N > L > O > M

Hence, M is the youngest.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All cups are chairs.

II. All chairs are tables.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tables are cups.

II. Some chairs are tables.
questions.solution:
__**Important Concepts:**__

__
 
• Meaning of "Some A are B" in Syllogism - there is at least one point in A which is in B.
 
• Meaning of "All A are B" in Syllogism - each point of A is in B.
 
• Therefore, if "All A are B" is true, then "some A are B" and "Some B are A" are always true (100%).
 
• But *"Some B are not A" and "All B are A" are false (this case is considered as can't say)*__

 

We draw the least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/115932ee0fb86747a6a10361361112be22409896bda8da0026635c8039868840.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tables are cups → It’s true. (It is given that all cups are tables means some tables are cups definitely true) 

II. Some chairs are tables → It’s true. (All chair are table means some chairs are table is definitely true) 

Hence, both the conclusions are true.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

’Some’ is a subset of ‘All’. If in statements it is given that ‘All A are B’ then the conclusion ‘Some A are B’ would always be True. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2871ef400e3efbb1a729252c361ace4fe13f5488c4d2c0c010817416e6a436a3.png]

questions.question: What is the value of 11 + 12 + 13 + ……… + 35?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

11 + 12 + 13 + ……… + 35

**Formula Used:**

Sum of first n positive integers = [n(n + 1)/2]

**Calculation:**

11 + 12 + 13 + ……… + 35

Here, because the first 10 natural numbers have been removed, we get:

= [1 + 2 + 3 + ……+ 35] - [1 + 2 + 3 + ……+ 10]

= [(35 × 36)/2] - [(10 × 11)/2]

= 630 - 55 = 575

**∴ 11 + 12 + 13 + ……… + 35 = 575**

questions.question: What is the value of 38 ÷ 19 × 3 + 5?
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rules to solve the equation

Step-1: The part of the equation containing 'Brackets' must be solved first, and in the bracket,

Step-2: Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next,

Step-3: Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are solved

Step-4: At last, the part of the equation that contains 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be solved.

⇒ (38 ÷ 19) × 3 + 5 = 2 × 3 + 5

⇒ (2 × 3) + 5 = 5 + 6 = 11

∴ (38 ÷ 19) × 3 + 5 = 2 × 3 + 5 = 11

questions.question: What is the Highest Common Factor of 3/4 and 12/13?
questions.solution:
For fraction,

H.C.F = H.C.F of numerator/L.C.M of denominator

Numerators are 3 and 12

H.C.F of 3 and 12 = 3

Denominators are 4 and 13

L.C.M of 4 and 13 = 52

H.C.F = 3/52

questions.question: If 347P is divisible by 9, then what is the value of P?
questions.solution:
We know that if the sum of digits in a number is divisible by 9 then the number is divisible by 9.

Now 3 + 4 + 7 + P should be divisible by 9.

So, 14 + P should be divisible by 9.

Also P is a single digit number.

The number after 14 which is divisible by 9 is 18.

So P is = 18 - 14 = 4.

questions.question: Three taps A, B and C can ﬁll a tank in 27, 36 and 54 minutes respectively. If all the three taps are opened, then how much time (in minutes) it will take to completely ﬁll the tank?
questions.solution:
In one minute, A can fill 1/27 of the tank.

In one minute, B can fill 1/36 of the tank.

In one minute, C can fill 1/54 of the tank.

After one minuter when all A, B and C is open,

Level of water = 1/27 + 1/36 + 1/54 = 1/12

After 12 minute,

Level of water = 12 × (1/12) = 1

It will take 12 minutes to fill the tank when all three taps are opened.

Time taken in upstream = D/9

Difference in time taken = 4 hours

⇒ Tame taken in upstream - Time taken in downstream=4 hours

⇒ D/9 - D/15 = 4

⇒ (2/45)D = 4

⇒ D = 90 km

questions.question: If the stomach did not produce any hydrochloric acid, which enzyme will not function?
questions.solution:

• Gastric glands are found in the stomach.
 
• They secrete enzymes like Pepsin, and Rennin which act upon the Proteins.
 
• Glands in the mucous membrane which line the stomach make and store an inactive protein known as pepsinogen.
 
• When pepsinogen is released into the stomach and mixed with gastric juice, it is converted into pepsin.
 
• Pepsin partially degrades proteins into smaller units called peptides.
 
• **Without enough hydrochloric acid, pepsinogen does not convert to pepsin which does not allow for protein breakdown​**
 
• **The hydrochloric acid creates an acidic medium that facilitates the action of the enzyme pepsin in the stomach.**

 
 

 
 
Pepsin

 
 
 
It breaks down proteins into smaller peptides, therefore helping in the digestion of protein.

 
 
 

 
 
Lipase

 
 
 
It breaks down dietary fats into smaller molecules called fatty acids and glycerol. 

 
 
 

 
 
Renin

 
 
 
It eventually causes an increase in blood pressure, leading to restoration of perfusion pressure in the kidneys

 
 
 

 
 
Ptyalin

 
 

 
 
 
It is a form of amylase found in the saliva of humans and some other animals which lubricates the food in the mouth so that it can easily pass through food pipe.

questions.question: What are the dissolved and suspended impurities in sewage called?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**The dissolved and suspended impurities in sewage are generally referred to as **contaminants or pollutants**.*** Hence, Option 4 is correct.***

These can be further categorized into various types, including:

 
• **Organic matter:** Such as human waste, food scraps, and soaps.
 
• **Nutrients**: Including nitrogen and phosphorus compounds, which can promote excessive growth of algae in water bodies (eutrophication).
 
• **Pathogens**: Bacteria, viruses, and parasites that can cause diseases.
 
• **Chemicals:** These can include pharmaceuticals, pesticides, and industrial chemicals.
 
• **Microplastics**: Small plastic particles that persist in the environment.
 
• **Heavy metals**: Such as lead, mercury, and cadmium, which are toxic to aquatic life and humans.

The solid particles that are suspended in wastewater are often referred to as "suspended solids," while the dissolved ones can be nutrients, certain organic compounds, or other soluble materials. Proper treatment of sewage is necessary to remove or reduce these impurities before the water is released back into the environment or reused.

questions.question: Who among the following discovered laws of planetary motion?
questions.solution:
Kepler's three laws of planetary motion can be described as follows:

The path of the planets about the sun is elliptical in shape, with the center of the sun being located at one focus. (The Law of Ellipses)

An imaginary line drawn from the center of the sun to the center of the planet will sweep out equal areas in equal intervals of time. (The Law of Equal Areas)

The ratio of the squares of the periods of any two planets is equal to the ratio of the cubes of their average distances from the sun. (The Law of Harmonies)
